sounds.ko: 드래그로 적 4명 이상 맞힘 — 와장창 손맛
sounds.text: Satisfying crunchy multi-hit impact: a grainy gravel-like crunch layered over a short deep thump, like many small ghosts squashed at once.
A heavy iron tower shield slams down into a concrete floor: a deep boomy thud with a bright metallic clang, the steel rings briefly and dies out.

sounds.ko: 가디언 드래그 — 방패벽 패널이 차례로 켜짐
sounds.text: Six very quick tiny electronic blips rising step by step in pitch, like glowing blue hexagonal energy panels switching on one after another in a row.
A wide rushing shockwave bursting out to both sides from a planted iron shield, a rising heavy whoosh, with a short buzzy low taunting honk on top. Heavy and heroic.

Close steady buzzing hum of a flat wall of glowing blue hexagonal energy panels, tight and slightly high, with a faint electric crackle flickering along the edges. Seamless steady texture with no start or end hit.

Translucent blue energy shield panels break apart in a fast dense burst: five glassy cracks blended into one full, thick, loud crunching shatter with tumbling shards, bright and full-bodied, not thin clicks.

sounds.ko: 팔라딘 드래그 — 금빛 낙인이 타 들어감
sounds.text: A golden holy brand burns into the ground: a hot crackling sizzle with a bright rising tone, like glowing gilded metal searing stone.
Two soft bright holy chime notes rising one after the other, a small golden blessing sparkle.
Holy light gathering before a strike: a rising radiant swell with three quick throbbing pulses growing stronger, tense build-up.
A huge pillar of holy light crashes down: a deep heavy boom with a sharp crack and bright ringing church-bell tones, followed by a short shower of tiny glittering sparkles.

sounds.ko: 워든 드래그 — 사슬 투척 + 감아 당김
sounds.text: Heavy iron chains thrown out and yanked back: a dull thud, a fast accelerating rattle of chain links, a dragging swish and a hard metal clack at the end.
A ring of heavy iron chains snaps tight and crushes: a deep heavy thump with a gritty earthy crunch, slightly distorted and grim.
Very soft small jingle of loose hanging iron chain links with a faint low trembling rune hum underneath. Quiet and short.
Four heavy iron stakes toppling over one after another: loud full metallic clanks with weight and body, stepping down in pitch, with a chain rattle, dense and clearly audible, not thin ticks.
A quick footstep tap, a sharp rising sword-dash whoosh, then four rapid bright katana slash rings, each one a little higher.
A single fast sword swish on the way back, a crisp airy thin-blade whoosh falling in pitch.
All the slash marks burst at once: a sharp tearing slash-blast over a short thump, a clear ringing steel tone, then a crisp click of a katana sliding back into its sheath.

sounds.ko: 버서커 드래그 — 도약 후 낙하 쿵
sounds.text: A short rising whoosh of a heavy body falling from above, then after about a tenth of a second a massive ground-pounding slam: deep distorted thud with flying gravel and rock debris.

A quick airy swell like a sharp intake of breath for about 0.2 seconds, then three loud heavy rock-cracking crunches as the ground splits open, dense and powerful, over a deep rumbling earth boom that holds for a moment.
A muffled burst of fire erupting from cracks in the ground with a low thump, then a hissing sizzle of cooling lava fading out.
A dark inky swell that cuts off, then three quick soft popping bursts of shadow clones rising in pitch, each with a tiny sharp click like a mark being stamped.
A reversed whooshing swell of dark ink sucking inward for a quarter second, cut off sharply by two fast crossing blade slashes and a brittle glassy shatter, then one low dark bell tone ringing out.
A light landing thud with a gust of wind, then a wooden longbow creaking as the string is drawn back tight.
One arrow released: a short taut bowstring twang and a quick airy hiss of the arrow flying away.
A quarter-second rising whine of power charging on a bow, then a huge arrow fired with a sharp crack and a punchy boom, a piercing bright ring and a crisp critical 'ting'.
A magic rune circle drawing itself on the ground: a low warm wavering arcane hum that swells and fades, with a faint glassy shimmer.
A small fiery meteor lands: a short soft whump and a bright little pop with a tiny crackle of embers.
A descending whistle of a giant fireball falling from the sky for about three quarters of a second, then a massive fiery explosion with a deep distorted boom and rumbling debris settling down.
Steady low bubbling of a small pool of hot lava, thick glooping bubbles popping now and then over a soft deep rumble. Seamless steady texture with no start or end hit.
A light landing thump, then a pump-action shotgun racked twice: crisp mechanical clack-clack, clack-clack.
A punchy cartoon shotgun blast, short and boomy with a burst of buckshot, followed by two tiny brass shell casings tinkling on the floor.

sounds.ko: 거너 드래그 — 장전 → 슬러그 한 방 + 반동
sounds.text: A crisp metallic click and a thin rising whine of a heating barrel for about 0.3 seconds, then a huge heavy slug shot: a deep booming blast with strong recoil and a short skidding slide.
A beam of warm golden light descends from the sky: a soft falling shimmering 'shing' that blooms into a gentle sustained bright glow of harmonious tones, airy and healing.
One tiny soft healing chime, a single gentle golden sparkle. Quiet and short.

sounds.ko: 클레릭 드래그 — 성역의 종이 울림 + 기절
sounds.text: A soft rising airy whoosh that grows for about 0.6 seconds as a great golden bell descends, then one deep resonant bronze bell strike, by far the loudest moment, ringing out warmly with a small bright 'ting' on top.

sounds.ko: 메딕 드래그 — 응급 십자 + 대기 카드 회복
sounds.text: A soft thump of a first-aid kit landing, two quick rising electronic medical-device beeps, and two tiny bright pings.
A quick soft pneumatic 'pfft' of a small syringe dart being shot, tiny and airy.
A defibrillator charging with a fast rising electronic whine, then a sharp crackling electric zap with a low buzzy jolt, ending in a single heart-monitor beep.
Eight paper talismans flicking out in a quick fluttering burst, a dry wooden clack, a sweeping ink-brush stroke, and a low eerie trembling hum as a seal ring binds.
A short rising eerie hiss, then a heavy drum-like boom as the seal bursts, paper talismans crackling as they burn, a whooshing ghost-fire flame flying off and a small soft healing chime.

One cheerful plucked lute note with a soft kick drum underneath and a second higher pluck right after, a bright musical downbeat. Single mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy, clean and dry, no background noise, no speech, no vocals.

Two bright rising chime notes, a sparkling little musical flourish as golden notes fly away. Single mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy, clean and dry, no background noise, no speech, no vocals.

Two quick plucked lute notes a third apart, struck almost together, a light bright musical accent. Single mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy, clean and dry, no background noise, no speech, no vocals.

A big bright strummed major chord on plucked strings with a crash cymbal and a punchy kick drum, one short triumphant fortissimo hit ringing out. Single mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy, clean and dry, no background noise, no speech, no vocals.
A clock tick-tock and a thin glass crack splitting with a falling shimmering tone, like a glass clock face fracturing.
A clockwork ratchet winding faster and faster, rapid accelerating ticks of tiny gears spinning backwards.
A reversed cymbal swell rising quickly and cutting off abruptly, like time being rewound, with a faint rising tone.
A clear bell-like clock chime rings as a glass clock face shatters into tinkling pieces, followed by four quick soft ticks of a clock hand winding back.
A quick whoosh of a spinning paper doll thrown on a string, a papery pop as it lands, a small wooden clack and a short wobbly twang of taut thread.

sounds.ko: 퍼펫티어 드래그 — 인형 사이 실이 이어짐
sounds.text: A single taut thread plucked: a slightly eerie wavering twang of a tight string that quivers and fades.

sounds.ko: 퍼펫티어 드래그 — 실 장판 틱 (아주 작게)
sounds.text: A tiny faint scratch of a thin thread rubbing, very short and quiet.

sounds.ko: 탱커 드래그 기본 착지 (전용 소리가 없을 때)
sounds.text: A heavy armored character lands hard: a deep weighty thud falling in pitch with a low rumbling dust tail.
A heavy armored character charging forward: a low, slightly long whoosh of air with weight behind it.

sounds.ko: 근접딜러 드래그 기본 착지 (전용 소리가 없을 때)
sounds.text: Starts instantly, no silence at the start: a nimble fighter lands with a short punchy kick-like thump at the very first moment, the loudest part, followed by a sharp falling blade-wind swish.
A fast sharp dash whoosh, a high rush of air quickly falling in pitch.

sounds.ko: 원거리딜러 드래그 기본 착지 (전용 소리가 없을 때)
sounds.text: A light landing: a crisp small click and a soft wooden 'tok' dropping slightly in pitch.
A light quick sidestep: a short airy whoosh with a soft rattle of arrows in a leather quiver.

sounds.ko: 힐러 드래그 기본 착지 (전용 소리가 없을 때)
sounds.text: A gentle soft landing glow: two warm smooth tones in harmony swelling softly and fading, calm and healing.
A soft airy dash whoosh with a faint gentle sparkle trailing behind.

sounds.ko: 서포터 드래그 기본 착지 (전용 소리가 없을 때)
sounds.text: A bouncy cute landing: a soft round plucked 'tung' with a light higher overtone, playful.
A bouncy hop forward: a quick springy cartoon boing with a short playful whoosh.
A heavy iron shield bash on a monster: a deep thud with a short bright clang of steel.
A gilded holy blade strike: a solid thud with a soft bright church-bell ring and a little warm healing shimmer.
A heavy iron chain swung around and yanked in: a low thump with a quick rattling clatter of chain links.
A fast spinning katana slash: a sharp circular swish with two bright ringing steel tones.
A brutal heavy axe chop into the ground: a short distorted thump with a gritty earthy crunch.
A sneak attack from the shadows: a hushed dark inky swell ending in a quick soft stab.

A powerful piercing arrow shot: a crisp bowstring snap and a long rushing wind whoosh of the arrow flying straight. Loud, close-up and clearly audible, the sound starts immediately at full volume with no silence before it.
A frost orb bursts: a soft magic pop with a wobbling glassy arcane shimmer and a crackle of ice.
A single punchy cartoon armor-piercing shot: a crisp gunpowder crack with a short low thump.
A warm gentle blessing: two soft glowing tones in harmony with a small golden bell shimmer, calm and uplifting.
A quick medical injection: a tiny syringe 'pfft' and two short rising electronic medical-device beeps over a soft healing tone.
A paper talisman thrown and bursting: a crisp papery flutter-snap followed by a dry wooden clack, slightly eerie.
A short cheerful two-note plucked lute phrase rising, bright and encouraging. Single mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy, clean and dry, no background noise, no speech, no vocals.
A clock-hand slash: a crisp clock tick-tock followed by a quick thin swish, like a second hand cutting the air.
A thin thread wrapping tightly around a monster: a quick wavering string twang with a soft rubbing squeak, slightly eerie.
